channel.title: The Grant Desk - Media Arts, Film & Sound, Africa, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Media Arts, Film & Sound, Africa, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 31 Aug 2026
Pulitzer Center: Global South Civil Society Microgrants 2026
item.description: Pulitzer Center · deadline Closed 06 Sep 2026 · USD 2,000 to USD 4,000 per project. Applicants name the amount requested and submit a draft budget. Funds are transferred to the partner after the agreement is signed; partners file a financial narrative and outcomes report at the end but are NOT required to collect detailed receipts. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• University of Johannesburg Artists in Residence 2027
    https://arts.uj.ac.za/artists-in-residence/
    UJ Arts & Culture, University of Johannesburg · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Stipend of ZAR 12,000 per month across a 10-month residency, so roughly ZAR 120,000 in total. No travel or accommodation budget on top of the stipend, and studio or rehearsal space is limited rather than guaranteed. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Marrakech IFF: Atlas Workshops 2026 (Films in Shooting or Post-Production)
    https://atlasateliers.marrakech-festival.com/en/call-for-applications
    Festival International du Film de Marrakech (Atlas Workshops) · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · No application fee. Participation in the online and onsite programme is covered. Cash prizes are awarded by a dedicated jury at the close of the Workshops; the festival does not publish the prize amounts on the call page.
  • Marrakech IFF: Atlas Station 2026 (Producers Track)
    https://atlasateliers.marrakech-festival.com/en/call-for-applications
    Festival International du Film de Marrakech (Atlas Workshops) · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · No application fee. Participation in the online and onsite professional programme is covered.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 08 Jun 2026
item.description:
• EUNIC: Spaces of Culture 2026 (Call for Proposals)
    https://eunic.eu/news/spaces-of-culture-2026
    EUNIC (European Union National Institutes for Culture) · deadline Closed 21 Jun 2026 · Up to EUR 50,000 per project; minimum 5 percent co-funding required from partners. Projects implemented 1 September 2026 to 31 August 2027.
